Add to My Bookmarks All items from Danelectro Add your review User Reviews of the Danelectro Wasabi Distortion AX-1 Submitted by AULOS from Hereford Uk (488 points) on Jun 4, 2008 I used to use this to make a tube amp match a modern amp for the style of music I was playing at the time. This pedal has some built in preset which are all pretty much the same. The knobs seem pretty weak. There is a hidden one that is really hard to turn. It's a cool shape, based on a car, but the tone is tiny and really high gain. Can't really get much range out of it. The stomp buttons and spungy and not really thar responsive. It does have a nice boost on it though which is actually pretty good. I sold it for . Good Points: Good boost, Looks cool. Bad Points: No range, Crappy buttons, Weak knobs. Price Paid: US$100.00 Purchased At: Nick Fisher Music Was this review helpful to you? Yes No Submitted by skinsuit from Toronto (14 points) on Dec 28, 2004 picked up the wasabi distortion and the overdrive pedals today, they are going back tomorrow. when changing between eq modes your signal drops out, and the change is not always clean sometimes it gets caught inbetween. makes this thing useless to me. also the bass knob is impossible to tweak without moving treble knob or holding it still.. Good Points: 5 / 10 db boost is cool. neat design (thou a bit big) Bad Points: see review. Price Paid: US$119.00 Purchased At: canadian - songbird Was this review helpful to you?
